WITH user_payments AS (
  -- one row per payment that was not refunded, with its user and its UTC month
  SELECT s.user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) AS DATE) AS pay_month
  FROM payments AS p
  JOIN subscriptions AS s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
),
cohorts AS (
  -- one row per paying user: the UTC month of the first payment
  SELECT user_id, MIN(pay_month) AS cohort_month
  FROM user_payments
  GROUP BY user_id
),
retained AS (
  -- one row per user who paid in the third month after the cohort month
  SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id
  FROM cohorts AS c
  JOIN user_payments AS up
    ON up.user_id = c.user_id
   AND up.pay_month = CAST(c.cohort_month + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS DATE)
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(r.user_id) / COUNT(*), 1)
FROM cohorts AS c
LEFT JOIN retained AS r ON r.user_id = c.user_id
WHERE c.cohort_month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND c.cohort_month < DATE '2025-07-01'
